0.zh: 当我正在看电视时，电话铃响了。
0.en: I was watching TV when the telephone rang.
I could swim a long way when I was a child.

0.zh: 那位好客的服务员教了我几句意大利语。
0.en: The friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
He never gets up early on Sundays.

1.zh: 他告诉我有人已经报了警。
1.en: He told me that someone had already called the police.

1.zh: 当两个侦探在门口站岗时，另外两个人进了屋。
1.en: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, the other two men entered the room.

1.zh: 比尔的花园比乔的花园大。
1.en: Bill's garden is larger than Joe's.

1.zh: 这架古钢琴是1681年在德国制造的。
1.en: The clavichord was made in Germany in 1681.

1.zh: 我的车现在正在被一位机械师修理。
1.en: My car is being repaired by a mechanic now.

2.zh: 明天这个时候他们将在车站迎接那些歌手。
2.en: This time tomorrow they will be meeting the singers at the station.

2.zh: 我们将在码头为他送行。
2.en: We shall meet him at the harbour.

2.zh: 秘书告诉我哈姆斯沃斯先生要见我。
2.en: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.

2.zh: 他一上车就开始跟我讲话。
2.en: As soon as he had got into the car, he began to talk to me.

2.zh: 目前他们正在全国各地巡回演出。
2.en: At present they are visiting all parts of the country.

2.zh: 我们为他感到非常自豪。
2.en: We are very proud of him.

3.zh: 尽管下着大雨，他还是来了。
3.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he came.

3.zh: 她将不得不扮演一个少女。
3.en: She will have to play the part of a young girl.
The play may begin at any moment.

3.zh: 他常常钓几个小时鱼却什么也没钓到。
3.en: He often fishes for hours without catching anything.

3.zh: 他们没有钓到鱼，却钓上来一只旧靴子。
3.en: Instead of catching fish, they caught an old boot.

3.zh: 她一定至少三十五岁了。
3.en: She must be at least thirty-five.

4.zh: 过往的飞机日夜都能被听到。
4.en: Passing planes can be heard night and day.

4.zh: 我已经被提供了一份新工作。
4.en: I have been offered a new job.

4.zh: 我女儿从未想过会收到一位外国姑娘的来信。
4.en: My daughter never dreamed of receiving a letter from a foreign girl.

4.zh: 两个女孩定期给彼此写信。
4.en: The two girls write to each other regularly.

4.zh: 他既不会说法语，也不会说德语。
4.en: He speaks neither French nor German.

4.zh: 我不仅回答了问题，还提了一个问题。
4.en: I not only answered the question, but asked one as well.

5.zh: 很多人假装他们懂现代艺术。
5.en: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.

5.zh: 她总是告诉我这幅画是否好看。
5.en: She always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.

5.zh: 自从他搬进来后，就一直和邻居闹矛盾。
5.en: Ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with his neighbours.

5.zh: 那辆“出租汽车”是一架叫“皮勒特斯·波特”号的小飞机。
5.en: The 'taxi' is a small plane called a 'Pilatus Porter'.

5.zh: 他跑得如此快，以至于我们追不上他。
5.en: He ran so fast that we could not catch up with him.

5.zh: 他是少数相信神话的人之一。
5.en: He is one of those rare people who believes in myths.

6.zh: 他小时候常在一家小铺里做工。
6.en: As a boy he used to work in a small shop.

6.zh: 他的工作是修理自行车。
6.en: It was his job to repair bicycles.

6.zh: 丹·鲁宾逊焦虑了整整一个星期。
6.en: Dan Robinson has been worrying for a whole week.

6.zh: 在信中他被要求去一趟警察局。
6.en: In the letter he was asked to call at the police station.

6.zh: 我看见他上了公共汽车。
6.en: I saw him get on the bus.

6.zh: 这是一个如此有趣的故事，以至于我们都笑了。
6.en: It was such a funny story that we all laughed.

7.zh: 黛比打算明天横渡英吉利海峡。
7.en: Debbie is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.

7.zh: 明天这个时候他将在岸边焦急地注视着她。
7.en: This time tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously from the shore.

7.zh: 我们都盼望着观看奥运会。
7.en: We are all looking forward to watching the Olympic Games.

7.zh: 他刚一回到英国就买了一幢房子。
7.en: He had no sooner returned to England than he bought a house.

7.zh: 他表现得就好像他从未在英国生活过一样。
7.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.

7.zh: 医生拒绝告诉他手术是否成功。
7.en: The doctor refused to tell him whether the operation had been successful.

8.en: You needn't have said those words.

8.zh: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了那句话。
8.en: I regretted saying it almost at once.

8.zh: 虽然开始很顺利，但他们很快就陷入了困境。
8.en: Though things went well at first, they soon got into trouble.

8.zh: 看来飞机肯定能飞过那些山脉。
8.en: It seemed certain that the plane would be able to fly over the mountains.

8.zh: 当她追上他们时，她看见他们正在打开那个包。
8.en: When she caught up with them, she saw that they were opening the bag.

8.zh: 山姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了。
8.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.

9.zh: 有人突然想到打开箱子看看。
9.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open the box.

9.zh: 他对所看到的一切感到惊讶。
9.en: He was astonished at what he saw.

9.zh: 作为回答，我要么点头，要么发出声音。
9.en: In answer to these questions, I either nodded or made some noise.

9.zh: 那年轻人直到床摔碎才醒来。
9.en: The young man did not wake up until the bed was smashed to pieces.

9.zh: 虽然床被砸碎了，但年轻人却没有受伤。
9.en: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the young man was not hurt.
